Bumped @ start. Rolled fwd & led on rail by 1/2L early . Held lead on inside midrace & headed @ 500m. Weakened from home turn. # Led & tired
Bit Slow Out Ridden Along early Settled Down Mid Field 4l same to turn worked off fence Straightening Up Middle Of Track has to steady 400 comes back inner Battled last 200 Fitter # run ended 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After passing the 400m was directed in across heels of another runner which shifted out abruptly when not fully clear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (2.5L from lead). Stayed same until held up Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & hit top @ 100m. Ran on well late & got up on line. # Got up on line
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 600m was steadied when momentarily awkwardly placed inside heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Niggled early & raced 4th 3 Wide No Cover (2L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken Five Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & raced greenly but held ground in last 200m. # Wide/stuck on OK.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.
